title.zh: 宣布每年2月1日为北甘马粦省Jose Maria C. Panganiban日及全省特别工作假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring February First of Every Year as "Jose Maria C. Panganiban Day" and a Special Working Public Holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte
title.orig: An Act Declaring February First of Every Year as "Jose Maria C. Panganiban Day" and a Special Working Public Holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9090_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: It is a declared policy of the State to give priority activities to foster patriotism and nationalism among the Filipinos in general, and the youth in particular.

In recognition of Jose Maria C. Panganiban's sacrifices and his fight for humanitarian reforms for his beloved country, and for placing him among the heroes and great men whose death or birth anniversaries are given appropriate recognition and honor by way of declaring their respective date of death or date of birth as a special working public holiday, it is hereby declared that February 1st of every year as "Jose Maria C. Panganiban Day" and a special working public holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
